# Implementation Plan: Blog Website Application

## Phase 1: Project scaffold
- Initialize package metadata.
- Add Express dependency and server entry point.
- Create the public assets directory.

## Phase 2: UI shell
- Build the blog list screen.
- Add a detailed article view panel.
- Add admin form for creating blogs.

## Phase 3: Blog logic
- Implement localStorage read/write helpers.
- Create blog object model and validation.
- Render blog cards dynamically.

## Phase 4: Summary generation
- Add a summary generation function based on article text.
- Bind it to the admin action button.
- Persist generated summary with each blog.

## Phase 5: Validation
- Run the app locally.
- Verify blog creation, viewing, and summary generation.
- Confirm the UI remains responsive and valid.

## Definition of done
- A visitor can view a blog list.
- A selected blog can be opened and read in detail.
- An admin can create a blog with title and content.
- A generated summary is shown and saved.
- The app loads quickly and works on responsive layouts.
